comparison.objective: Hot-swap a failing base-station battery for a charged spare.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual make-before-break exchange under a short outage constraint.
comparison.success_condition: Correct spare installed within a 4-second empty-bay limit, failing pack binned, and no pack mishandled.
comparison.reason: Timed battery exchange tests coordinated transfer, not countertorque locking of an adjustable mechanical setting.
